name: data.egov.kz gbd_ul (State Database of Legal Entities)
note: Open legal-entities register. REQUIRES a FREE API key (register on data.egov.kz). Verified: 403 'API key is required' without a key. Fields: BIN, name, registration date, legal address, OKED activity, director name. Key = BIN (12-digit). Confirm the current version string; redact director name (personal data).

name: KGD taxpayer search (by BIN)
note: State Revenue Committee taxpayer search + published lists (VAT payers, inactive/pseudo taxpayers). Browser-public; per-BIN/IIN search and downloadable XLSX lists. Adds tax/VAT status.
